description: Report the server version, the active provider (innertube or api) for video info, comments, and search, and which backend serves each tool. Transcript tools always use youtube-transcript-plus.
name: get_server_info

authenticated.description: Whether the provider sends credentials (a YouTube Data API key)

exactSearchFilters.description: Whether search_youtube applies every sortBy and uploadDate option exactly, without warnings

provider.description: Value of YT_PROVIDER; selects the backend for video info, comments, and search
